<!-- Shared by index.qmd and es/index.qmd. Expects OJS variables `lang`, `root`. -->
```{ojs}
//| echo: false
import { strings } from "/assets/strings.js"
import { link, split } from "/assets/catalog.js"
t = strings[lang]
catalog = d3.json(root + "data/catalog.json")
years = catalog.map(d => d.year).filter(Boolean)
stats = [
  [catalog.length, t.statDatasets],
  [new Set(catalog.map(d => d.publisher)).size, t.statRepos],
  [new Set(catalog.flatMap(d => split(d.taxa))).size, t.statTaxa],
  [years.length ? `${d3.min(years)}–${d3.max(years)}` : "–", t.statYears]
]
htl.html`<section class="hero">
  <h1>${t.tagline}</h1>
  <p>${t.lede}</p>
  <div class="stats">${stats.map(([n, l]) => htl.html`<div class="stat"><b>${n}</b><span>${l}</span></div>`)}</div>
</section>`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
ways = [
  ["explore.html", t.cardExplore, t.cardExploreText],
  ["browse.html", t.cardBrowse, t.cardBrowseText],
  ["map.html", t.cardMap, t.cardMapText],
  ["submit.html", t.cardSubmit, t.cardSubmitText]
]
htl.html`<h2>${t.waysIn}</h2>
<div class="ways">${ways.map(([href, h, p]) => htl.html`<a class="way" href="${href}"><h3>${h}</h3><p>${p}</p></a>`)}</div>`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
featured = catalog.filter(d => d.featured)
htl.html`<h2>${t.featured}</h2>
${featured.length === 0 ? htl.html`<p>${t.none}</p>` : featured.map(d => htl.html`
  <div class="dataset-card">
    <h4><a href="${link(d)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${d.title}</a></h4>
    <div class="dataset-meta">${d.creators || ""} · ${d.year ?? ""} · ${d.publisher || ""}</div>
    ${(lang === "es" ? d.note_es : d.note_en) ? htl.html`<p class="mt-2 mb-0">${lang === "es" ? d.note_es : d.note_en}</p>` : ""}
  </div>`)}`
```
